name: Vocal peak ceiling
desc: Clean limiter at −4 dBFS with a 120 ms release after the vocal compressor: screams and plosives held

refs.why: FOH Brian Pomp ends the lead vocal chain on a limiter
refs.source: Vintage King, Brian Pomp FOH interview, 2017

notes: The doc's vocal row. A stage singer's peaks overshoot any compressor's attack: this is the last word
